EX-99.1 2 ck0001991792-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 PIVOT-006 Phase 3 Registrational Trial Demonstrates Unprecedented Improvement in Recurrence-Free Survival (RFS) for Intermediate-Risk and High-Grade Ta Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC) - Cretostimogene reduced the risk of recurrence by 68%, demonstrating a statistically significant and clinically meaningful benefit with a hazard ratio of 0.32 (95% CI: 0.23, 0.45; p<0.0001) - Compelling safety and tolerability results, no Grade 3 or higher TRAEs and no treatment-related discontinuations - PIVOT-006 topline results to be presented as a late-breaking podium presentation at the Society of Urologic Oncology Annual Meeting on December 2, 2026 - PIVOT-006 data will support a second BLA submission in intermediate-risk and high-grade Ta NMIBC anticipated in Q2 2027 - Based on FDA feedback, initial BLA submission in BCG-unresponsive NMIBC to be broadened to include both CIS and high-grade papillary-only disease; completion anticipated in March 2027 Dallas, TX, November 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CG Oncology, Inc.

(NASDAQ: CGON) today announced positive topline results from PIVOT-006, its Phase 3 registrational trial evaluating adjuvant intravesical cretostimogene grenadenorepvec in patients with intermediate-risk and high-grade Ta ≤3 cm NMIBC, following complete tumor resection.
